intro.en: On the overnight train Southern Star, the Duchess's sapphire necklace vanishes from the locked safe in the luggage car between Alder Crossing and Port Elling. Four people had a reason to be near it. Who took it?
intro.pt: No trem noturno Southern Star, o colar de safira da Duquesa desaparece do cofre trancado no vagão de bagagem entre Alder Crossing e Port Elling. Quatro pessoas tinham motivos para estar por perto. Quem roubou?

suspects.name: Helena Costa

persona.en: Proud, by the book, afraid of losing her job.
persona.pt: Orgulhosa, metódica, com medo de perder o emprego.

alibi.en: She was at the door of sleeper 7 talking to Victor when the lights came back after the tunnel.
alibi.pt: Ela estava na porta da cabine-leito 7 conversando com Victor quando as luzes voltaram após o túnel.

suspects.facts: You are Helena Costa, the train conductor. At Alder Crossing you locked the Duchess's sapphire necklace in the luggage car safe, and you keep the only key on your ring. When the lights went out in Black Ridge Tunnel you were walking to sleeper 7, and when they came back you were at its door talking to Victor. At Port Elling you found the safe open with flour smudges on its handle. You are proud and by the book, and you never admit that your key ring hangs on a hook in the dining car during dinner service.

suspects.name: Victor Hale

persona.en: Smooth talker, hides that he owes money.
persona.pt: Bom de lábia, esconde que deve dinheiro.

alibi.en: In sleeper 7 all night, opened the door to Helena in pajamas when the lights came back.
alibi.pt: Na cabine-leito 7 a noite toda, abriu a porta para Helena de pijama quando as luzes voltaram.

suspects.facts: You are Victor Hale, a jeweller travelling in sleeper 7. You valued the necklace for the Duchess and know it is worth a fortune. You stayed in sleeper 7 all night; during the blackout you heard Tomás singing in car 4, and when the lights came back you opened the door to Helena in your pajamas. You hide that you owe money and get defensive if asked about it, but you did not take the necklace.

suspects.name: Tomás Reyes

alibi.en: During the blackout he was in the corridor of car 4, at the far end from the luggage car, singing to calm passengers.
alibi.pt: Durante o apagão, ele estava no corredor do vagão 4, longe do vagão de bagagem, cantando para acalmar os passageiros.

suspects.facts: You are Tomás Reyes, the night porter. At Grey Hollow you loaded mailbags on the platform while Helena watched. During the blackout in Black Ridge Tunnel you stood in the corridor of car 4 singing to calm the passengers. Right after the tunnel you saw someone in a white chef's apron leave the luggage car, but you did not see a face. You are cheerful and love gossip.

suspects.name: Inês Duarte

persona.en: Warm and busy, always smelling of fresh bread; quick to offer food and slow to answer.
persona.pt: Calorosa e atarefada, sempre com cheiro de pão fresco; rápida para oferecer comida e lenta para responder.

alibi.en: Cleaning the dining car kitchen alone during the blackout.
alibi.pt: Limpando a cozinha do vagão-restaurante sozinha durante o apagão.

suspects.facts: You are Inês Duarte, the dining car chef, and you took the necklace. During dinner you copied Helena's safe key while her key ring hung on the dining car hook. During the Black Ridge Tunnel blackout you slipped into the luggage car, opened the safe and hid the necklace in a flour tin in your kitchen. You lie that you were cleaning the kitchen alone the whole time. You never admit touching the safe or the key, and you stay calm and friendly.

event.en: Departure; Helena locks the necklace in the luggage car safe.
event.pt: Partida; Helena tranca o colar no cofre do vagão de bagagem.

event.en: Victor goes to sleeper 7; Inês closes the dining car.
event.pt: Victor vai para a cabine-leito 7; Inês fecha o vagão-restaurante.

event.en: 10 minute stop; Tomás loads mailbags on the platform.
event.pt: Parada de 10 minutos; Tomás carrega sacos de correio na plataforma.

event.en: The lights go out for 4 minutes; the necklace is taken.
event.pt: As luzes se apagam por 4 minutos; o colar é roubado.

event.en: Helena finds the safe open and empty.
event.pt: Helena encontra o cofre aberto e vazio.

clues.ask: What did you see right after the tunnel?

text.en: Right after the tunnel I saw someone in a white chef's apron leave the luggage car.
text.pt: Logo depois do túnel, vi alguém de avental branco de cozinha saindo do vagão de bagagem.

clues.ask: Did you notice anything on the safe?

text.en: At Port Elling I found flour smudges on the safe handle.
text.pt: Em Port Elling, encontrei manchas de farinha no puxador do cofre.

clues.ask: Who was with you when the lights came back?

text.en: Helena was at my door when the lights came back.
text.pt: A Helena estava na minha porta quando as luzes voltaram.

clues.ask: Where was Victor when the lights came back?

text.en: Victor opened sleeper 7 in his pajamas when the lights came back, three cars from the luggage car.
text.pt: O Victor abriu a cabine-leito 7 de pijama quando as luzes voltaram, a três vagões do vagão de bagagem.

clues.ask: Did you hear anything during the blackout?

text.en: During the blackout I heard Tomás singing in car 4, far from the luggage car.
text.pt: Durante o apagão, ouvi o Tomás cantando no vagão 4, longe do vagão de bagagem.

solution.en: Inês Duarte took the necklace during the tunnel blackout with a copied key and hid it in a flour tin; the apron seen by Tomás and the flour on the safe point to her; Helena, Victor and Tomás are cleared by each other's accounts.
solution.pt: Inês Duarte pegou o colar durante o apagão no túnel com uma chave copiada e o escondeu em uma lata de farinha; o avental visto por Tomás e a farinha no cofre a incriminam; Helena, Victor e Tomás estão inocentados pelos depoimentos uns dos outros.
